build_task_template: build a phyre task template that places a ball above obstacle bars to reach the ground
create_obstacle_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable width, x position, and y position in the scene
create_obstacle_with_hole: create a second obstacle bar with a gap defined by left and right segments
add_vertical_blockers: add vertical blocker bars on top of left and right obstacle segments
define_task_relationship: define a task assignment where a dynamic ball must touch the bottom wall
